seasons.review_body: Duranga premiered on ZEE5 on 2 December 2022. An official Hindi adaptation of the acclaimed Korean drama Flower of Evil, the 9-episode series follows a police investigator who begins to suspect her seemingly perfect husband may be a serial killer. Stars Gulshan Devaiah and Drashti Dhami.
